```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(salmonMSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4#, out.width = "650px", comment = "#>"
)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```


```{r}
pop <- "Salmon"
if(pop=="Salmon") {
  ERM <- readRDS(here("CM/Salmon_08.18.26.prior.rds"))
  year1 <- 2002
}
report <- salmonMSE:::get_report(ERM)
d <- salmonMSE:::get_CMdata(ERM@.MISC$CMfit)


d1 <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Historical years", "Age classes", "MCMC iterations"),
  Value = c(d$Ldyr, d$Nages, length(report))
)
kable(d1, caption = "Table D1. Projection parameters")

df_pars <- rstan::summary(ERM)$summary %>%
  round(3) %>%
  as.data.frame()
# kable(df_pars[, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "50%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")])


df_summary <- df_pars[c("log_cr", "log_so", "moadd", "logit_vulPT[1]", "logit_vulPT[2]", "logit_vulPT[3]", "log_FbasePT", "sd_matt[1]", "sd_matt[2]", "sd_matt[3]", "wt_sd", "wto_sd", "fanomalyPT_sd"),
        c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "50%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")]
row.names(df_summary) <- c("*log(κ)*", "*log(S^rep^)*", "*M^add^*", "*logit(μ^vPT^~a=1~)*", "*logit(μ^vPT^~a=2~)*", "*logit(μ^vPT^~a=3~)*", "*log(a^PT^)*", "*σ^m^~a=1~*", "*σ^m^~a=2~*", "*σ^m^~a=3~*", "*σ~δ~*", "*σ~M~*", "*σ~FPT~*")
kable(df_summary, escape=FALSE, caption = "Table D2. Parameter estimates from the conditioning model: mean, standard deviation, 2.5th percentile, 50th percentil, 97.5th percentile, effective sample size and Rhat values")

# Replace parameter names with greek symbols

```




```{r legend }

df_legend <- data.frame(Names= c("log_cr", "log_so", "moadd", "logit_vulPT[1]", "logit_vulPT[2]", "logit_vulPT[3]", "log_FbasePT", "sd_matt[1]", "sd_matt[2]", "sd_matt[3]", "wt_sd", "wto_sd", "fanomalyPT_sd"))

row.names(df_legend) <- c("*log(κ)*", "*log(S^rep^)*", "*M^add^*", "*logit(μ^vPT^~a=1~)*", "*logit(μ^vPT^~a=2~)*", "*logit(μ^vPT^~a=3~)*", "*log(a^PT^)*", "*σ^m^~a=1~*", "*σ^m^~a=2~*", "*σ^m^~a=3~*","*σ~δ~*", "*σ~M~*", "*σ~FPT~*")

kable(df_legend, caption = "Table D3. Legend for names of parameter values used in code, for reference for output figures")
```

# MCMC Outputs


```{r trace-cr, fig.cap="Figure D1. Wormplots of productivity parameters, scaling parameters and the log-posterior from MCMC iterations after thinning and warmup.", dpi = 800}
# log-posterior from MCMC iterations after thinning and warmup."}
pars_core <- c("cr", "log_so", "moadd", "log_FbasePT", "log_FbaseT", "lp")
salmonMSE:::CM_trace(ERM, pars_core)

```



```{r trace-vul, fig.cap="Figure D2. Wormplots of fishery vulnerability at age parameters from MCMC iterations after thinning and warmup.", dpi = 800}
# This does not work
pars_vul <- c("^logit_vul")
salmonMSE:::CM_trace(ERM, pars_vul)
```


```{r trace-var, fig.cap="Figure D3. Wormplots of variance parameters from MCMC iterations after thinning and warmup.", dpi = 800}
pars_var <- c("lnE_sd", "wt_sd", "wto_sd", "fanomalyPT_sd", "fanomalyT_sd", "sd_matt")
salmonMSE:::CM_trace(ERM, pars_var)
```

```{r pairs-cr, fig.cap="Figure D4. Marginal posterior distributions and correlations of productivity parameters, scaling parameters and the log-posterior (from MCMC iterations after thinning and warmup).", dpi = 800}
salmonMSE:::CM_pairs(ERM, pars_core)
```

```{r pairs-vul, fig.cap="Figure D5. Marginal posterior distributions and correlations for fishery vulnerability at age parameters.", dpi = 800}
CM_pairs(ERM, pars_vul)
```

```{r pairs-var, fig.cap="Figure D6. Marginal posterior distributions and correlations of variance parameters.", dpi = 800}
CM_pairs(ERM, pars_var)
```

```{r wt, fig.cap="Figure D7. Posterior estimates of egg mortality deviates from the stock-recruit relationship (medians and 95% prediction interval).", dpi = 800}
CM_wt(ERM, year1)
```

```{r wto, fig.cap="Figure D8. Posterior estimates of age 1 mortality deviates (medians and 95% prediction interval).", dpi = 800}
CM_wto(ERM, year1)
```

# Model input data and fits 

```{r hatch-rel, fig.cap="Figure D9. Total hatchery releases.", dpi = 800}
d <- salmonMSE:::get_CMdata(ERM@.MISC$CMfit)

salmonMSE:::CM_data(d$hatchrelease, (year1:(year1 + d$Ldyr)), ylab = "Hatchery release", xlab = "Release Year")

```

```{r fit-esc, fig.cap="Figure D10. Observed total escapement (return to river, points with dotted lines) and posterior predicted values (medians and 95% prediction interval).", dpi = 800}

d <- salmonMSE:::get_CMdata(ERM@.MISC$CMfit)
rs_names <- c("Smolt 0+")

salmonMSE:::CM_fit_esc(report, d, year1:(year1 + d$Ldyr-1))
```


```{r cwt-rel, fig.cap="Figure D11. Total CWT releases."}
salmonMSE:::CM_CWTrel(d$cwtrelease, year1, rs_names)
```

```{r fit-cwt-catpt, fig.cap="Figure D12. Observed coded wire tag preterminal catch at age (points with dotted lines) and posterior predicted values (medians and 95% prediction interval)."}
salmonMSE:::CM_fit_CWTcatch(report, d, PT = TRUE, year1, rs_names)
```


```{r fit-cwt-esc, fig.cap="Figure D13. Observed coded wire tag escapement at age (points with dotted lines) and posterior predicted values (medians and 95% prediction interval)."}
salmonMSE:::CM_fit_CWTesc(report, d, year1, rs_names)
```

# Model outputs


```{r SRR, fig.cap="Figure D14. Estimated stock-recruit relationship (medians and 95% prediction interval). Numbers correspond to years of egg production (predicts juvenile production for the following calendar year). Points show annual smolt production (medians).", warning=FALSE}
salmonMSE:::CM_SRR(report, year1)
```


```{r SrepPriorPost, fig.cap="Figure E15. Prior and posterior estimates of Srep, unfished equilibrium spawner abundances at replacement."}
# (paste("figures/", pop, "_priorpost.png", sep=""), g, height = 3.5, width = 6)
file <-  paste0(pop, "_priorpost.png")

knitr::include_graphics(here(
  "figures", file
 )
 )



```



```{r SmaxPriorPost, fig.cap="Figure D16. Habitat-based estimates of Smax with posterior estimates of Smax, spawner abundances at maximum recruitment."}
# (paste("figures/", pop, "_priorpost.png", sep=""), g, height = 3.5, width = 6)
file <-  paste0(pop, "_Smax_IWAM-post.png")

knitr::include_graphics(here(
  "figures", file
 )
 )



```

```{r prod, fig.cap="Figure D17. Estimate of life-cycle productivity, recuits/spawner."}
# (paste("figures/", pop, "_priorpost.png", sep=""), g, height = 3.5, width = 6)
file <-  paste0(pop, "_prod.png")

knitr::include_graphics(here(
  "figures", file
 )
 )



```



```{r Megg, fig.cap="Figure D18. Estimated egg-smolt instantaneous mortality rate (medians and 95% prediction interval)."}
salmonMSE:::CM_Megg(report, year1, ci = TRUE, surv = FALSE)
```



```{r vulPT, fig.cap="Figure D19. Posterior estimates of preterminal vulnerability at age (medians and 95% prediction interval)."}
FPT <- sapply(report, getElement, "FPT")
if (sum(FPT)) salmonMSE:::CM_vul(report, type = "vulPT")
```

```{r CYER-PT, fig.cap="Figure D20. Return year preterminal exploitation rate at age (medians and 95% prediction interval)."}
if (sum(FPT)) salmonMSE:::CM_ER(report, brood = FALSE, type = "PT", year1, r = d$r_matt)
```


```{r matt-RY, fig.cap="Figure D21. Posterior estimates of maturity by age and return year (medians and 95% prediction interval). Dashed, horizontal lines represent prior means."}
salmonMSE:::CM_maturity(report, d, year1, r = d$r_matt, brood = FALSE, rs_names = rs_names)
```

Full results (to be) available on github repository: https://github.com/Pacific-salmon-assess/UpperSoG_Chinook
